answer:
The most important thing: your stool test (FIT) on 2025-11-04 was positive, and I can't find any follow-up in your records, such as a colonoscopy or a referral. A positive FIT needs a colonoscopy, usually within a few months, so almost a year later this is overdue. Ask about it first.

Other things to raise:
- Diabetes: your A1c rose from 6.5% (2023) to 8.3% (Jan 2025), then came down to 7.6%, 7.1% and 6.9% (Feb 2026) after Jardiance was added in Feb 2025. That is a good trend. Metformin was stopped in April 2024, and the records don't say why, so ask. Your last A1c was in February 2026, so one is due again.
- Cholesterol: your LDL was 131 and total cholesterol 212 in Feb 2025, and atorvastatin was prescribed that same month. I see no cholesterol recheck since, so ask whether one is due to see if the statin is working.
- Kidneys: creatinine and eGFR are normal (eGFR 73 then 69), but with diabetes, a urine albumin test is usually done yearly. I see none in your records. Eye and foot exams are also not recorded.
- Last July's chest pain: the CT scan showed no pulmonary embolism, and the chest pain was recorded as resolved. The scan did note mild spine changes, which are common. Nothing is needed unless the pain returns.
- Vaccines and screening: no immunizations are recorded (flu, COVID, shingles, pneumonia, tetanus), and I see no mammogram or bone density test. These may simply be held elsewhere, so check. At 69 they are generally recommended.

My records cover only one hospital, so some of this may have happened elsewhere.
short: My FIT stool test was positive on 2025-11-04 with no colonoscopy recorded since. Also ask about a repeat A1c, a cholesterol recheck after starting atorvastatin, a urine albumin test, and vaccines and screening.
